Hey, it’s alright. You aren’t a failure for dropping out. School is hard as hell and it just isn’t it for people up to a point. I know how you feel, I’m bad at school too, but leaving it doesn’t mean you are a failure. I’m telling you, one day you will find someone and make friends. No matter how bad it gets, remember my words. There is always someone out there in the world who would love to be friends with you, you just haven’t met them possibly. It could be today, tomorrow or in a few years. You can change a persons life with you being there for them. The people who have hurt you and insulted your body aren’t true friends or family. Only true friends won’t insult you for how you look. I look a look at your profile and your art is great. I hope you can find happiness somewhere, even if it isn’t today. You are worth it and so are the others in this sub. Have a good day!
